content.local_resource_argument: Each computed residual uses exactly the single displayed matrix-vector query. Its remaining operations are a constant number of dot products and vector combinations of length d, plus scalar arithmetic, giving O(d) extra arithmetic. Exactly ell residuals are computed. Storing ell vectors of length d requires O(d ell) numbers; retaining only working vectors and ell coefficients requires O(d+ell). Normalization uses one scalar square root and one length-d scaling per retained column. Matrix-vector implementation costs are excluded from the extra arithmetic count.

variants.cost: Exactly ell matrix-vector calls, including the call that detects breakdown or reaches the budget. Each step additionally uses a bounded number of Euclidean dot products, vector linear combinations and scalar operations: O(d) arithmetic, hence O(d ell) total excluding matrix-vector implementation costs. Normalized output additionally charges one scalar square root per basis column and O(d ell) vector-scaling arithmetic. Working vectors require O(d) storage and coefficients O(ell); retaining the entire basis requires O(d ell) storage. Explicit matrix storage is separate. These are selected Algorithm costs, not unrestricted Oracle Complexity.
variants.implementation_details_ref: PDF p.12 / printed p.266, Eqs.(63)–(75), symmetric case; budget convention, output, normalization and resource accounting are explicit local bookkeeping.
variants.name: Unnormalized real symmetric minimized iteration
variants.output: Return b_0,...,b_{ell-1}, alpha_0,...,alpha_{ell-1}, beta_0,...,beta_{ell-2}, and terminal residual b_ell. The beta list is empty for ell=1. Optionally normalize the basis and assemble T_ell with diagonal alpha_j and symmetric adjacent entries ||b_i||_2/||b_{i-1}||_2 for 1<=i<ell. The residual is additional output, not another queried basis column. The returned span is invariant when the residual is zero; no Ritz accuracy guarantee is asserted.
public_inputs: Dimension d>=1, access to exact w=Ab, nonzero starting vector b_0, optional integer query budget t in [1,d] (default d).
variants.query_and_update: Query w_k=Ab_k once. Compute alpha_k=w_k^T b_k/||b_k||_2^2; for k>=1 compute beta_{k-1}=w_k^T b_{k-1}/||b_{k-1}||_2^2, and at k=0 use beta_{-1}=0. Form b_{k+1}=w_k-alpha_k b_k-beta_{k-1}b_{k-1}, omitting the last term at k=0. Compute its squared norm. Store coefficients and the requested basis vectors. Continue with k+1 only when the residual is nonzero and the budget permits another query.
variants.requirements: A=A^T in R^{d by d}. Exact matrix-vector products, Euclidean dot products, scalar/vector arithmetic and exact-zero testing. Square roots are needed only for normalized output.
variants.state_and_initialization: Set b_{-1}=0, beta_{-1}=0 and k=0. Retain current b_k and previous b_{k-1}, together with their squared Euclidean norms. Allocate basis storage when returning the entire basis.
variants.tuning_and_stopping: After each query stop if b_{k+1}=0, before division by its norm, or if k+1=t. Otherwise increment k. No tolerance or spectral tuning parameter is used. If m is the first exact breakdown index, exactly ell=min(t,m) queries are made.
